```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
```

```{r}
raw_data <- read.csv2(
  "../retrauci_abril_2026.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = TRUE
)

#summary(raw_data)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# TABLE OF EMPTY CELLS, LITERAL "NAS" VALUES, AND VALID VALUES
# FOR ALL VARIABLES
# ============================================================

missingness_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(names(raw_data), function(variable) {

    # Temporarily convert to text without modifying the original data frame
    x <- trimws(as.character(raw_data[[variable]]))

    total_n <- length(x)

    # Empty Excel cells are usually imported as NA.
    # This also includes empty strings or values containing only spaces.
    is_empty <- is.na(x) | (!is.na(x) & x == "")

    # Literal "NAS" text, case-insensitive
    is_literal_nas <- !is.na(x) & toupper(x) == "NAS"

    # Values that are neither empty nor "NAS"
    is_valid <- !is_empty & !is_literal_nas

    data.frame(
      variable = variable,

      n_empty = sum(is_empty),
      pct_empty = round(
        100 * sum(is_empty) / total_n,
        2
      ),

      n_literal_nas = sum(is_literal_nas),
      pct_literal_nas = round(
        100 * sum(is_literal_nas) / total_n,
        2
      ),

      n_empty_or_nas = sum(is_empty | is_literal_nas),
      pct_empty_or_nas = round(
        100 * sum(is_empty | is_literal_nas) / total_n,
        2
      ),

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
)

# Remove row names
rownames(missingness_summary) <- NULL

# Sort from highest to lowest percentage of empty cells plus NAS values
missingness_summary <- missingness_summary[
  order(
    -missingness_summary$pct_empty_or_nas,
    missingness_summary$variable
  ),
]

# Open the complete table in RStudio
View(missingness_summary)

```

# 1. Convert dates/times
```{r, echo=FALSE}

# Identify and report date/time values that cannot be parsed, then convert valid entries to standardized POSIXct format.
# Empty values are treated as missing (NA), while invalid formats are flagged before conversion.
# Format: POSIXct (date format)

date_vars <- intersect(c(
  "fecha_trauma", "fecha_ingreso_hospital", "fecha_ingreso_uci",
  "fecha_alta_uci", "fecha_alta_hospital", "fecha_exitus",
  "fecha_reingreso_uci", "fecha_alta_reingreso"
), names(raw_data))

time_vars <- intersect(c(
  "hora_trauma", "hora_ingreso_hospital",
  "hora_ingreso_uci", "hora_exitus"
), names(raw_data))

parse_columns <- function(data, vars, orders) {
  original <- data[vars]

  parsed <- lapply(original, function(x) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(x))
    x[x == ""] <- NA
    suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(x, orders = orders))
  })

  problems <- sapply(seq_along(vars), function(i) {
    x <- trimws(as.character(original[[i]]))
    sum(is.na(parsed[[i]]) & !is.na(x) & x != "")
  })

  names(problems) <- vars

  list(
    data = parsed,
    problems = problems[problems > 0]
  )
}

dates <- parse_columns(
  raw_data,
  date_vars,
  c("dmy", "ymd", "dmy HMS", "ymd HMS")
)

times <- parse_columns(
  raw_data,
  time_vars,
  c("HMS", "HM", "H M", "I M p")
)

raw_data[date_vars] <- dates$data
raw_data[time_vars] <- times$data

dates$problems
times$problems
```

# 2. Convert numeric variables
```{r, echo=FALSE}

# Clean and convert numeric variables to numeric format by trimming spaces, standardizing decimal separators, and setting invalid values to NA.
numeric_vars <- c(
  "edad",
  "creatinina_inicial", "creatinina_24h",
  "hemoglobina_inicial", "hemoglobina_24h",
  "hematocrito_inicial", "hematocrito_24h",
  "inr_inicial", "inr_24h",
  "protrombina_inicial", "protrombina_24h",
  "ttpa_inicial", "ttpa_24h",
  "fibrinogeno_inicial", "fibrinogeno_24h",
  "ph_inicial", "ph_24h",
  "exceso_base_inicial", "exceso_base_24h",
  "lactico_inicial", "lactico_24h",
  "etanol_cuantitativo_sangre",
  "fr_ph",
  "pto_fr", "pto_tas", "pto_gcs",
  "rts_t", "rts", "ps",
  "dias_uci", "dias_hospital",
  "rscore_edad", "rscore_pupilas",
  "retrascore"
)

regional_severity_vars <- grep("^lesion_\\d+_gravedad$", names(raw_data), value = TRUE)

numeric_vars <- intersect(
  unique(c(numeric_vars, regional_severity_vars)),
  names(raw_data)
)

numeric_vars <- numeric_vars[
  !vapply(raw_data[numeric_vars], is.numeric, logical(1))
]

numeric_problems <- sapply(raw_data[numeric_vars], function(x) {
  x2 <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x2 <- gsub(",", ".", x2)

  sum(
    is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x2))) &
      x2 != "" &
      !is.na(x2)
  )
})

numeric_problems[numeric_problems > 0]

raw_data[numeric_vars] <- lapply(raw_data[numeric_vars], function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x == ""] <- NA
  x <- gsub(",", ".", x)

  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
})
```

# 3. Candidate cohort based on the RETRASCORE paper

The cohort is constructed before the subsequent exclusions based on `edad` and
`sdmo`. Following the paper, the only exclusion criterion applied here is an
unavailable in-hospital mortality outcome. Missing predictor values are retained
so they can be described and a complete-case analysis or imputation can be
chosen later.

Operationalization decisions:

- ATLS-based management is a feature of the registry protocol, and no
  patient-level variable is available for use as a filter.
- In-hospital mortality combines `evolucion_uci` and
  `evolucion_hospitalaria`, because patients who die in the ICU generally do
  not have the hospital outcome field completed.
- The analytical outcome is `mortality_30d`: deaths within 30 days of trauma
  are coded as 1; live hospital discharges and deaths after day 30 are coded
  as 0. Deceased patients without a valid date retain an unknown outcome.
- `triss_death_probability` is calculated as `1 - ps/100`, because `ps` is
  stored as a survival percentage ranging from 0 to 100.
- Medical prehospital care is defined as `uvi movil` or `helicoptero`; the
  categories `no medicalizada`, `sin atencion prehospitalaria`, and
  `soporte vital enfermeria` form the reference group.
- Hemodynamic failure is approximated by `shock` or `shock refractario` in
  `situacion_hemodinamica`; respiratory failure is defined as PaO2/FiO2 less
  than or equal to 200 in `adrs`.
- `situacion_hemodinamica`, `adrs`, `coagulopatia`, `vmec_dico`, and
  `hemorragia_masiva` are assumed to represent the first 24 hours, as defined
  in the registry. The export has no timestamp that allows this to be verified
  for each patient.
- mais1-mais6 are used directly according to the current code mapping. In these
  fields, 0, an empty cell, NA, na, or NAS all mean that no lesion is present
  in that anatomical region and are therefore coded as 0.

```{r}
# Helper functions ---------------------------------------------------------

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", "na", "nas")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_number <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NAS")] <- NA_character_
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", x)))
}

# In-hospital outcome. Patients who die in the ICU generally have an empty
# hospital outcome, so both outcome fields are combined.
clean_icu_outcome <- clean_text(raw_data$evolucion_uci)
clean_hospital_outcome <- clean_text(raw_data$evolucion_hospitalaria)

in_hospital_mortality <- case_when(
  clean_icu_outcome %in% c("exitus", "exitus y donacion") ~ 1L,
  clean_hospital_outcome %in% c(
    "exitus", "exitus y donacion"
  ) ~ 1L,
  clean_hospital_outcome == "alta" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# Primary outcome from the paper: mortality within 30 days of trauma.
# fecha_alta_uci is used for ICU deaths and fecha_alta_hospital for deaths
# after ICU discharge. fecha_exitus is used as a fallback.
icu_death <- clean_icu_outcome %in% c(
  "exitus", "exitus y donacion"
)
hospital_death <- clean_hospital_outcome %in% c(
  "exitus", "exitus y donacion"
)

death_date <- as.POSIXct(
  rep(NA_real_, nrow(raw_data)),
  origin = "1970-01-01",
  tz = "UTC"
)
death_date[icu_death] <- raw_data$fecha_alta_uci[icu_death]
death_date[hospital_death] <- raw_data$fecha_alta_hospital[
  hospital_death
]

use_recorded_death_date <- in_hospital_mortality == 1 &
  is.na(death_date) & !is.na(raw_data$fecha_exitus)
use_recorded_death_date[is.na(use_recorded_death_date)] <- FALSE
death_date[use_recorded_death_date] <- raw_data$fecha_exitus[use_recorded_death_date]

days_to_death <- as.numeric(
  difftime(death_date, raw_data$fecha_trauma, units = "days")
)
valid_death_date <- !is.na(days_to_death) & days_to_death >= 0

# Survival beyond day 30 is considered 30-day survival even if the patient
# dies later; these later deaths are not excluded.
mortality_30d <- case_when(
  in_hospital_mortality == 0 ~ 0L,
  in_hospital_mortality == 1 &
    valid_death_date & days_to_death <= 30 ~ 1L,
  in_hospital_mortality == 1 &
    valid_death_date & days_to_death > 30 ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# Comparators used in the paper.
icu_length_of_stay_days <- clean_number(raw_data$dias_uci)
triss_survival_pct <- clean_number(raw_data$ps)
triss_death_probability <- ifelse(
  !is.na(triss_survival_pct) & triss_survival_pct >= 0 & triss_survival_pct <= 100,
  1 - triss_survival_pct / 100,
  NA_real_
)

# Patient-related variables -----------------------------------------------

clean_sex <- clean_text(raw_data$genero)
male <- case_when(
  clean_sex == "masculino" ~ 1L,
  clean_sex == "femenino" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

age <- clean_number(raw_data$edad)
age_category <- cut(
  age,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 49, 65, 75, Inf),
  labels = c("<50", "50-65", "66-75", ">75"),
  right = TRUE
)

clean_antiplatelet <- clean_text(raw_data$antiagregado)
clean_vka <- clean_text(raw_data$dicumarinicos)
clean_doac <- clean_text(raw_data$acod)

preinjury_antithrombotic <- case_when(
  clean_antiplatelet == "si" |
    clean_vka == "si" |
    clean_doac == "si" ~ 1L,
  clean_antiplatelet == "no" &
    clean_vka == "no" &
    clean_doac == "no" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# Prehospital variables ----------------------------------------------------

clean_prehospital_care <- clean_text(raw_data$atencion_prehospitalaria)
physician_prehospital_care <- case_when(
  clean_prehospital_care %in% c("uvi movil", "helicoptero") ~ 1L,
  clean_prehospital_care %in% c(
    "no medicalizada", "sin atencion prehospitalaria",
    "soporte vital enfermeria"
  ) ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

clean_prehospital_intubation <- clean_text(raw_data$iot_prehospitalaria)
prehospital_intubation <- case_when(
  clean_prehospital_intubation %in% c(
    "si", "si, con empleo de dispositivos de apoyo"
  ) ~ 1L,
  clean_prehospital_intubation == "no" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

clean_trauma_type <- clean_text(raw_data$tipo_trauma)
penetrating_trauma <- case_when(
  clean_trauma_type == "penetrante" ~ 1L,
  clean_trauma_type == "contuso" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

clean_mechanism <- clean_text(raw_data$mecanismo)
# Requested grouping: other and unknown form a single category.
# Empty values remain NA and are not included in this category.
clean_mechanism[clean_mechanism %in% c(
  "otro", "otros", "desconocido"
)] <- "otros/desconocido"
clean_intent <- clean_text(raw_data$intencionalidad)

injury_type <- factor(
  case_when(
    clean_intent == "no intencional : trafico" ~
      "Road Traffic accident",
    clean_intent == "no intencional : caida" ~ "Fall",
    clean_intent == "no intencional : laboral" ~
      "Occupational accident",
    clean_intent == "no intencional : deportivo" ~
      "Sport related",
    clean_intent == "intencionado : agresion" ~ "Assault",
    clean_intent == "intencionado : autolisis" ~ "Self-injury",
    clean_intent == "desconocido" ~ "Unknown",
    clean_intent == "no intencional : otras actividades" ~
      "Other",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  levels = c(
    "Road Traffic accident", "Fall", "Occupational accident",
    "Sport related", "Assault", "Self-injury", "Unknown", "Other"
  )
)

high_risk_mechanism <- case_when(
  clean_mechanism %in% c(
    "arma de fuego", "atropello", "caida accidental", "otros/desconocido"
  ) ~ 1L,
  clean_mechanism == "precipitacion" &
    clean_intent == "intencionado : autolisis" ~ 1L,
  !is.na(clean_mechanism) & clean_mechanism != "precipitacion" ~ 0L,
  clean_mechanism == "precipitacion" &
    !is.na(clean_intent) ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# Physiological variables --------------------------------------------------

clean_pupils <- clean_text(raw_data$pupilas_ingreso)
pupil_category <- factor(
  case_when(
    clean_pupils == "sin alteraciones" ~ "normal",
    clean_pupils == "midriasis unilateral" ~ "midriasis unilateral",
    clean_pupils == "midriasis bilatera" ~ "midriasis bilateral",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ),
  levels = c("normal", "midriasis unilateral", "midriasis bilateral")
)

gcs_total <- clean_number(raw_data$gcs_total_introducido)
gcs_le_8 <- ifelse(
  is.na(gcs_total), NA_integer_, as.integer(gcs_total <= 8)
)

# Anatomical variables -----------------------------------------------------
# RETRAUCI regional MAIS variables are used directly:
# mais1 head, mais2 upper extremity, mais3 thorax, mais4 abdomen,
# mais5 lower extremity, and mais6 external/thermal injuries.
# In this export, 0, an empty MAIS cell, NA, na, and NAS all mean that no injury
# is present in that region and are coded as 0. Other non-numeric values or
# values outside the AIS 0-6 range are retained as missing.

convert_regional_mais <- function(x) {
  text_value <- trimws(as.character(x))
  is_empty <- is.na(text_value) | text_value == "" |
    toupper(text_value) %in% c("NA", "NAS")
  result <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", ".", text_value)))
  result[is_empty] <- 0
  result[!is.na(result) & !(result %in% 0:6)] <- NA_real_
  result
}

dichotomize_mais <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_integer_, as.integer(x >= 3))
}

head_ais <- convert_regional_mais(raw_data$mais1)
upper_extremity_ais <- convert_regional_mais(raw_data$mais2)
thorax_ais <- convert_regional_mais(raw_data$mais3)
abdomen_ais <- convert_regional_mais(raw_data$mais4)
lower_extremity_ais <- convert_regional_mais(raw_data$mais5)
external_ais <- convert_regional_mais(raw_data$mais6)

# Organ failures within the first 24 hours --------------------------------

clean_hemodynamic_status <- clean_text(raw_data$situacion_hemodinamica)
hemodynamic_failure <- case_when(
  clean_hemodynamic_status %in% c("shock", "shock refractario") ~ 1L,
  clean_hemodynamic_status %in% c(
    "estable", "inestable remonta con volumen"
  ) ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

clean_respiratory_status <- clean_text(raw_data$adrs)
respiratory_failure <- case_when(
  clean_respiratory_status %in% c("<100", "101-200") ~ 1L,
  clean_respiratory_status %in% c("no", "201 -300", "> 300") ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

clean_coagulopathy <- clean_text(raw_data$coagulopatia)
coagulopathy_24h <- case_when(
  clean_coagulopathy == "si" ~ 1L,
  clean_coagulopathy == "no" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# Treatments within the first 24 hours ------------------------------------

clean_mechanical_ventilation <- clean_text(raw_data$vmec_dico)
mechanical_ventilation <- case_when(
  clean_mechanical_ventilation == "si" ~ 1L,
  clean_mechanical_ventilation == "no" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

clean_massive_hemorrhage <- clean_text(raw_data$hemorragia_masiva)
massive_hemorrhage <- case_when(
  clean_massive_hemorrhage == "si" ~ 1L,
  clean_massive_hemorrhage == "no" ~ 0L,
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# Final cohort -------------------------------------------------------------

retrascore_cohort <- data.frame(
  row_id = seq_len(nrow(raw_data)),
  medical_record = raw_data$historia,
  registry_record = raw_data$registro,
  hospital = raw_data$hospital,
  trauma_year = year(raw_data$fecha_trauma),
  in_hospital_mortality = in_hospital_mortality,
  mortality_30d = mortality_30d,
  days_to_death = days_to_death,
  icu_length_of_stay_days = icu_length_of_stay_days,
  triss_death_probability = triss_death_probability,
  male = male,
  age = age,
  age_category = age_category,
  preinjury_antithrombotic = preinjury_antithrombotic,
  physician_prehospital_care = physician_prehospital_care,
  prehospital_intubation = prehospital_intubation,
  penetrating_trauma = penetrating_trauma,
  injury_type = injury_type,
  grouped_mechanism = clean_mechanism,
  high_risk_mechanism = high_risk_mechanism,
  pupils = pupil_category,
  gcs_total = gcs_total,
  gcs_le_8 = gcs_le_8,
  head_ais = head_ais,
  head_mais = dichotomize_mais(head_ais),
  thorax_ais = thorax_ais,
  thorax_mais = dichotomize_mais(thorax_ais),
  abdomen_ais = abdomen_ais,
  abdomen_mais = dichotomize_mais(abdomen_ais),
  upper_extremity_ais = upper_extremity_ais,
  upper_extremity_mais = dichotomize_mais(upper_extremity_ais),
  lower_extremity_ais = lower_extremity_ais,
  lower_extremity_mais = dichotomize_mais(lower_extremity_ais),
  external_ais = external_ais,
  external_mais = dichotomize_mais(external_ais),
  hemodynamic_failure = hemodynamic_failure,
  respiratory_failure = respiratory_failure,
  coagulopathy_24h = coagulopathy_24h,
  mechanical_ventilation = mechanical_ventilation,
  massive_hemorrhage = massive_hemorrhage
)

initial_n <- nrow(retrascore_cohort)
unknown_outcome_n <- sum(
  is.na(retrascore_cohort$in_hospital_mortality)
)

retrascore_cohort <- retrascore_cohort %>%
  filter(!is.na(in_hospital_mortality))

cohort_flow <- data.frame(
  stage = c(
    "Initial records",
    "Excluded: unknown in-hospital mortality",
    "RETRASCORE cohort"
  ),
  n = c(initial_n, unknown_outcome_n, nrow(retrascore_cohort))
)

cohort_flow
table(retrascore_cohort$mortality_30d, useNA = "ifany")

outcome_30d_summary <- data.frame(
  measure = c(
    "Eligible cohort",
    "Evaluable 30-day outcome",
    "Deaths within 30 days",
    "In-hospital deaths after 30 days",
    "Deaths without a valid date to determine 30-day status"
  ),
  n = c(
    nrow(retrascore_cohort),
    sum(!is.na(retrascore_cohort$mortality_30d)),
    sum(retrascore_cohort$mortality_30d == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(
      retrascore_cohort$in_hospital_mortality == 1 &
        retrascore_cohort$days_to_death > 30,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    sum(
      retrascore_cohort$in_hospital_mortality == 1 &
        is.na(retrascore_cohort$mortality_30d)
    )
  )
)

outcome_30d_summary

# Availability of all candidate variables in the cohort.
cohort_missingness_summary <- data.frame(
  variable = names(retrascore_cohort),
  n_missing = vapply(retrascore_cohort, function(x) {
    sum(is.na(x))
  }, numeric(1)),
  pct_missing = round(vapply(retrascore_cohort, function(x) {
    100 * mean(is.na(x))
  }, numeric(1)), 2),
  row.names = NULL
)

cohort_missingness_summary <- cohort_missingness_summary[
  order(-cohort_missingness_summary$pct_missing),
]
cohort_missingness_summary
```

# Preprocessed cohort

The preprocessed data remain available in memory as the `retrascore_cohort`
object. This document does not write an RDS file or any other data file.

# Logistic regression with an 80/20 split

The model uses the same 13 predictors included in the final logistic regression
from the previous study. Complete cases are split into training (80%) and test
(20%) sets. The split is stratified by 30-day mortality and uses a fixed seed
for reproducibility. The model is fitted only in the training set.

```{r logistic-regression}
# Variables retained in the previous study.
selected_predictors <- c(
  "age_category",
  "preinjury_antithrombotic",
  "prehospital_intubation",
  "high_risk_mechanism",
  "pupils",
  "gcs_le_8",
  "head_mais",
  "thorax_mais",
  "hemodynamic_failure",
  "respiratory_failure",
  "coagulopathy_24h",
  "mechanical_ventilation",
  "massive_hemorrhage"
)

outcome_variable <- "mortality_30d"
required_variables <- c(outcome_variable, selected_predictors)
model_variables <- c("row_id", required_variables)
missing_variables <- setdiff(required_variables, names(retrascore_cohort))

if (length(missing_variables) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The following model variables are missing: ",
    paste(missing_variables, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Logistic regression uses complete cases for the outcome and all predictors.
complete_case_rows <- complete.cases(
  retrascore_cohort[, required_variables, drop = FALSE]
)
model_data <- droplevels(
  retrascore_cohort[complete_case_rows, model_variables, drop = FALSE]
)

if (nrow(model_data) == 0L) {
  stop("No complete cases are available for model fitting.")
}
if (!identical(sort(unique(model_data[[outcome_variable]])), c(0L, 1L))) {
  stop("The model outcome must contain both 0 and 1.")
}

# Create a reproducible outcome-stratified 80/20 split.
set.seed(20261027)
row_indices_by_outcome <- split(
  seq_len(nrow(model_data)),
  model_data[[outcome_variable]]
)

training_indices <- sort(unlist(lapply(row_indices_by_outcome, function(indices) {
  sample(indices, size = round(0.80 * length(indices)), replace = FALSE)
})))

training_data <- model_data[training_indices, , drop = FALSE]
test_data <- model_data[-training_indices, , drop = FALSE]

model_formula <- reformulate(
  termlabels = selected_predictors,
  response = outcome_variable
)

logistic_model <- glm(
  formula = model_formula,
  data = training_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  na.action = na.fail
)

if (!isTRUE(logistic_model$converged)) {
  stop("The logistic regression did not converge.")
}
if (anyNA(coef(logistic_model))) {
  stop("The logistic regression contains non-estimable coefficients.")
}
```

## Analysis sample

```{r split-summary-table, echo=FALSE}
split_summary_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = c("Full preprocessed cohort", "Complete cases", "Training", "Test"),
  N = c(
    nrow(retrascore_cohort),
    nrow(model_data),
    nrow(training_data),
    nrow(test_data)
  ),
  Deaths = c(
    sum(retrascore_cohort$mortality_30d == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    sum(model_data$mortality_30d == 1),
    sum(training_data$mortality_30d == 1),
    sum(test_data$mortality_30d == 1)
  ),
  `Mortality (%)` = round(100 * c(
    mean(retrascore_cohort$mortality_30d, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(model_data$mortality_30d),
    mean(training_data$mortality_30d),
    mean(test_data$mortality_30d)
  ), 2),
  check.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  split_summary_table,
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Cohort and 80/20 split summary"
)
```

## Logistic regression results

Odds ratios and 95% confidence intervals are derived from the model fitted in
the training set. Confidence intervals are Wald intervals.

```{r logistic-regression-results, echo=FALSE}
coefficient_matrix <- summary(logistic_model)$coefficients

model_results_table <- data.frame(
  Term = rownames(coefficient_matrix),
  Estimate = coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"],
  `Standard error` = coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"],
  `Odds ratio` = exp(coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"]),
  `95% CI lower` = exp(
    coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"] -
      1.96 * coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"]
  ),
  `95% CI upper` = exp(
    coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"] +
      1.96 * coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"]
  ),
  `P value` = coefficient_matrix[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

numeric_result_columns <- c(
  "Estimate", "Standard error", "Odds ratio", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper"
)
model_results_table[numeric_result_columns] <- lapply(
  model_results_table[numeric_result_columns],
  round,
  digits = 3
)
model_results_table$`P value` <- format.pval(
  model_results_table$`P value`,
  digits = 3,
  eps = 0.001
)

knitr::kable(
  model_results_table,
  align = c("l", rep("r", 6)),
  caption = "Multivariable logistic regression in the 80% training set"
)
```

## Model performance

```{r model-performance-table, echo=FALSE}
calculate_auc <- function(observed, predicted_probability) {
  cases <- observed == 1
  controls <- observed == 0
  number_of_cases <- sum(cases)
  number_of_controls <- sum(controls)

  if (number_of_cases == 0L || number_of_controls == 0L) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  probability_ranks <- rank(predicted_probability, ties.method = "average")
  (sum(probability_ranks[cases]) -
    number_of_cases * (number_of_cases + 1) / 2) /
    (number_of_cases * number_of_controls)
}

evaluate_model <- function(data, sample_name) {
  predicted_probability <- predict(
    logistic_model,
    newdata = data,
    type = "response"
  )

  data.frame(
    Sample = sample_name,
    N = nrow(data),
    Deaths = sum(data$mortality_30d),
    `Observed mortality (%)` = 100 * mean(data$mortality_30d),
    AUC = calculate_auc(data$mortality_30d, predicted_probability),
    `Brier score` = mean(
      (data$mortality_30d - predicted_probability)^2
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

model_performance_table <- rbind(
  evaluate_model(training_data, "Training (80%)"),
  evaluate_model(test_data, "Test (20%)")
)

performance_columns <- c("Observed mortality (%)", "AUC", "Brier score")
model_performance_table[performance_columns] <- lapply(
  model_performance_table[performance_columns],
  round,
  digits = 3
)

knitr::kable(
  model_performance_table,
  align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"),
  caption = "Model performance in the training and test sets"
)
```

# Data-driven variable selection

The following analyses do not use the predictors retained by the previous
study as prior information. Both methods start from the same set of 20 eligible
clinical candidate predictors. Identifiers, year, other outcomes, variables
measured after the outcome, and the TRISS prediction are excluded.

Variable selection is performed exclusively in the same stratified 80%
training sample defined for the first logistic regression. Patients with
complete data for all 20 candidates retain their original training or test
assignment through `row_id`. The 20% test sample is not used for variable
selection or model estimation.

```{r variable-selection-data}
required_selection_packages <- c("glmnet", "MASS", "pROC")
missing_selection_packages <- required_selection_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_selection_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_selection_packages) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Install the following packages before running variable selection: ",
    paste(missing_selection_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# All eligible predictors are offered to both selection methods without
# assigning priority to any variable.
candidate_predictors <- c(
  "age_category",
  "male",
  "preinjury_antithrombotic",
  "physician_prehospital_care",
  "prehospital_intubation",
  "penetrating_trauma",
  "high_risk_mechanism",
  "pupils",
  "gcs_le_8",
  "head_mais",
  "thorax_mais",
  "abdomen_mais",
  "upper_extremity_mais",
  "lower_extremity_mais",
  "external_mais",
  "hemodynamic_failure",
  "respiratory_failure",
  "coagulopathy_24h",
  "mechanical_ventilation",
  "massive_hemorrhage"
)

selection_variables <- c("row_id", outcome_variable, candidate_predictors)
missing_candidate_variables <- setdiff(
  selection_variables,
  names(retrascore_cohort)
)

if (length(missing_candidate_variables) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "The following candidate variables are missing: ",
    paste(missing_candidate_variables, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

selection_complete_rows <- complete.cases(
  retrascore_cohort[, selection_variables, drop = FALSE]
)
selection_data <- droplevels(
  retrascore_cohort[
    selection_complete_rows,
    selection_variables,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

if (nrow(selection_data) == 0L) {
  stop("No complete cases are available for variable selection.")
}

# Preserve the exact patient assignment from the first 80/20 split.
selection_training_data <- selection_data[
  selection_data$row_id %in% training_data$row_id,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
selection_test_data <- selection_data[
  selection_data$row_id %in% test_data$row_id,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (
  nrow(selection_training_data) + nrow(selection_test_data) !=
    nrow(selection_data)
) {
  stop("Some selection patients were not found in the original 80/20 split.")
}

selection_formula <- reformulate(
  termlabels = candidate_predictors,
  response = outcome_variable
)
```

## LASSO selection

LASSO selection uses ten outcome-stratified cross-validation folds in the
training sample. Predictors are standardized by `glmnet`, and the conservative
`lambda.1se` value determines the selected model. A categorical predictor is
considered selected when at least one of its indicator coefficients is nonzero.

```{r lasso-selection}
training_design_matrix_full <- model.matrix(
  selection_formula,
  data = selection_training_data
)
training_design_matrix <- training_design_matrix_full[, -1, drop = FALSE]
training_outcome <- selection_training_data[[outcome_variable]]

design_assignment <- attr(training_design_matrix_full, "assign")[-1]
selection_term_labels <- attr(terms(selection_formula), "term.labels")

set.seed(20261028)
number_of_folds <- 10L
fold_id <- integer(length(training_outcome))

for (outcome_level in sort(unique(training_outcome))) {
  level_indices <- which(training_outcome == outcome_level)
  fold_id[level_indices] <- sample(rep(
    seq_len(number_of_folds),
    length.out = length(level_indices)
  ))
}

lasso_cv_model <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  x = training_design_matrix,
  y = training_outcome,
  family = "binomial",
  alpha = 1,
  foldid = fold_id,
  type.measure = "deviance",
  standardize = TRUE
)

lasso_coefficients <- as.numeric(
  coef(lasso_cv_model, s = "lambda.1se")[-1, 1]
)
names(lasso_coefficients) <- colnames(training_design_matrix)

lasso_term_strength <- vapply(
  seq_along(selection_term_labels),
  function(term_index) {
    max(abs(lasso_coefficients[design_assignment == term_index]))
  },
  numeric(1)
)
names(lasso_term_strength) <- selection_term_labels

lasso_selected_predictors <- names(lasso_term_strength)[
  lasso_term_strength > 0
]
```

## Stepwise selection

Bidirectional stepwise selection starts from the full 20-predictor logistic
model and minimizes Akaike's information criterion (AIC). It uses the same
training patients as LASSO.

```{r stepwise-selection}
full_selection_model <- glm(
  formula = selection_formula,
  data = selection_training_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  na.action = na.fail
)

if (!isTRUE(full_selection_model$converged)) {
  stop("The full model used for stepwise selection did not converge.")
}

stepwise_model <- MASS::stepAIC(
  full_selection_model,
  direction = "both",
  trace = FALSE
)

if (!isTRUE(stepwise_model$converged)) {
  stop("The stepwise logistic regression did not converge.")
}

stepwise_selected_predictors <- attr(
  terms(stepwise_model),
  "term.labels"
)
```

## Logistic models using the selected variables

The selection methods determine the predictor sets only. Two standard,
unpenalized multivariable logistic regressions are then fitted in the same 80%
training sample: one using the variables selected by LASSO and one using those
selected by stepwise AIC.

```{r selected-logistic-models}
lasso_refit_formula <- reformulate(
  termlabels = lasso_selected_predictors,
  response = outcome_variable
)
stepwise_refit_formula <- reformulate(
  termlabels = stepwise_selected_predictors,
  response = outcome_variable
)

lasso_refit_model <- glm(
  formula = lasso_refit_formula,
  data = selection_training_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  na.action = na.fail
)
stepwise_refit_model <- glm(
  formula = stepwise_refit_formula,
  data = selection_training_data,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  na.action = na.fail
)

if (!isTRUE(lasso_refit_model$converged) || anyNA(coef(lasso_refit_model))) {
  stop("The logistic model using LASSO-selected variables is not estimable.")
}
if (!isTRUE(stepwise_refit_model$converged) || anyNA(coef(stepwise_refit_model))) {
  stop("The logistic model using stepwise-selected variables is not estimable.")
}
```

## Selected-variable table

```{r selected-variable-table, echo=FALSE}
selection_results_table <- data.frame(
  `Candidate predictor` = candidate_predictors,
  `Maximum absolute LASSO coefficient` = unname(
    lasso_term_strength[candidate_predictors]
  ),
  `Selected by LASSO` = ifelse(
    candidate_predictors %in% lasso_selected_predictors,
    "Yes",
    "No"
  ),
  `Selected by stepwise AIC` = ifelse(
    candidate_predictors %in% stepwise_selected_predictors,
    "Yes",
    "No"
  ),
  `Selected by both` = ifelse(
    candidate_predictors %in% intersect(
      lasso_selected_predictors,
      stepwise_selected_predictors
    ),
    "Yes",
    "No"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)

selection_results_table$`Maximum absolute LASSO coefficient` <- round(
  selection_results_table$`Maximum absolute LASSO coefficient`,
  4
)

knitr::kable(
  selection_results_table,
  align = c("l", "r", "c", "c", "c"),
  caption = "Predictors selected independently by LASSO and stepwise AIC"
)
```

## Coefficients of the refitted logistic models

The following are ordinary logistic-regression coefficients, not penalized
LASSO coefficients. Confidence intervals are Wald 95% intervals.

```{r coefficient-table-function, echo=FALSE}
logistic_coefficient_table <- function(model) {
  coefficient_matrix <- summary(model)$coefficients
  critical_value <- qnorm(0.975)

  result <- data.frame(
    Term = rownames(coefficient_matrix),
    Coefficient = coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"],
    `Standard error` = coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"],
    `Odds ratio` = exp(coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"]),
    `OR 95% CI lower` = exp(
      coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"] -
        critical_value * coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"]
    ),
    `OR 95% CI upper` = exp(
      coefficient_matrix[, "Estimate"] +
        critical_value * coefficient_matrix[, "Std. Error"]
    ),
    `P value` = coefficient_matrix[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    check.names = FALSE,
    row.names = NULL
  )

  numeric_columns <- setdiff(names(result), c("Term", "P value"))
  result[numeric_columns] <- lapply(
    result[numeric_columns],
    round,
    digits = 3
  )
  result$`P value` <- format.pval(
    result$`P value`,
    digits = 3,
    eps = 0.001
  )
  result
}
```

### Logistic regression with LASSO-selected variables

```{r lasso-coefficient-table, echo=FALSE}
lasso_coefficient_table <- logistic_coefficient_table(lasso_refit_model)

knitr::kable(
  lasso_coefficient_table,
  align = c("l", rep("r", 6)),
  caption = paste(
    "Logistic regression fitted with the variables selected by LASSO",
    "in the original 80% training split"
  )
)
```

### Logistic regression with stepwise-selected variables

```{r stepwise-coefficient-table, echo=FALSE}
stepwise_coefficient_table <- logistic_coefficient_table(stepwise_refit_model)

knitr::kable(
  stepwise_coefficient_table,
  align = c("l", rep("r", 6)),
  caption = paste(
    "Logistic regression fitted with the variables selected by stepwise AIC",
    "in the original 80% training split"
  )
)
```

## Training and test AUC of the refitted logistic models

Predictions use the two unpenalized logistic models refitted after variable
selection. Performance is reported both in the 80% training sample and in the
untouched patients from the original 20% test split who have complete data for
all candidate predictors. The test AUC therefore measures discrimination in
patients who were not used for variable selection or coefficient estimation.
AUC 95% confidence intervals are calculated with DeLong's method.

```{r selection-performance-table, echo=FALSE}
lasso_training_probability <- predict(
  lasso_refit_model,
  newdata = selection_training_data,
  type = "response"
)
lasso_test_probability <- predict(
  lasso_refit_model,
  newdata = selection_test_data,
  type = "response"
)
stepwise_training_probability <- predict(
  stepwise_refit_model,
  newdata = selection_training_data,
  type = "response"
)
stepwise_test_probability <- predict(
  stepwise_refit_model,
  newdata = selection_test_data,
  type = "response"
)

evaluate_selection_predictions <- function(
  method,
  sample_name,
  observed,
  predicted_probability,
  number_of_selected_predictors
) {
  roc_object <- pROC::roc(
    response = observed,
    predictor = predicted_probability,
    levels = c(0, 1),
    direction = "<",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  auc_confidence_interval <- as.numeric(
    pROC::ci.auc(roc_object, method = "delong")
  )

  data.frame(
    Method = method,
    Sample = sample_name,
    `Selected predictors` = number_of_selected_predictors,
    N = length(observed),
    Deaths = sum(observed),
    AUC = calculate_auc(observed, predicted_probability),
    `AUC 95% CI lower` = auc_confidence_interval[1],
    `AUC 95% CI upper` = auc_confidence_interval[3],
    `Brier score` = mean(
      (observed - predicted_probability)^2
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}

selection_performance_table <- rbind(
  evaluate_selection_predictions(
    method = "Logistic model with LASSO-selected variables",
    sample_name = "Training (80%)",
    observed = selection_training_data$mortality_30d,
    predicted_probability = lasso_training_probability,
    number_of_selected_predictors = length(lasso_selected_predictors)
  ),
  evaluate_selection_predictions(
    method = "Logistic model with LASSO-selected variables",
    sample_name = "Test (20%)",
    observed = selection_test_data$mortality_30d,
    predicted_probability = lasso_test_probability,
    number_of_selected_predictors = length(lasso_selected_predictors)
  ),
  evaluate_selection_predictions(
    method = "Logistic model with stepwise-selected variables",
    sample_name = "Training (80%)",
    observed = selection_training_data$mortality_30d,
    predicted_probability = stepwise_training_probability,
    number_of_selected_predictors = length(stepwise_selected_predictors)
  ),
  evaluate_selection_predictions(
    method = "Logistic model with stepwise-selected variables",
    sample_name = "Test (20%)",
    observed = selection_test_data$mortality_30d,
    predicted_probability = stepwise_test_probability,
    number_of_selected_predictors = length(stepwise_selected_predictors)
  )
)

performance_columns <- c(
  "AUC", "AUC 95% CI lower", "AUC 95% CI upper", "Brier score"
)
selection_performance_table[performance_columns] <- lapply(
  selection_performance_table[performance_columns],
  round,
  digits = 3
)

knitr::kable(
  selection_performance_table,
  align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 7)),
  caption = paste(
    "Training and test performance with DeLong 95% AUC confidence intervals",
    "for the logistic models refitted after variable selection"
  )
)
```
